title: 3Dシミュレーション
subtitle: Computer Aided Design and Simulation
keywords: CAE 2.Finite element method 3.Solid modeling 4.Stress analysis 5.Regional collaboration
educationalGoal: CAE (Computer Aided Engineering) system is a technology for the design optimization/enhancement by utilizing FEM (Finite Element Method) based on CAD (Computer Aided Design). In this course, students will understand the FEM theory/overview and specific methods for application to mechanical design. Then, students will study the design/analysis approaches of mechanical structures through stress and deformation analysis by FEM. Furthermore, students will deepen their knowledge by understanding CAE problems in actual companies.
advice: Design and manufacturing are important fundamental technologies supporting Japanese economic power. They can be roughly classified into the hardware manufacturing technology, where high-precision components are efficiently processed and assembled into products, the software technology, which efficiently supports the complicated and wide-ranging design/manufacturing activities. This course will focus on the CAE system, which efficiently supports various activities of engineers from design to manufacturing. Students will study their functions and applications. Classes will consist of lectures on system functions/structures and computer-aided practices. In addition, students will understand the practical usage of CAE at the actual design section and its role.
books: Textbooks: Unspecified Reference books: Unspecified Reserved books: Unspecified
requiredKnowledge: “Strength of Materials” and “Materials Science” are fundamental courses to understand this course. Therefore, it is desirable to acquire the knowledge of “Strength of Materials” and “Materials Science”. If students recognize the insufficiency in understanding this knowledge during practicing, they should do a lot of review.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand FEM theory/overview and select analysis method for usage to actual design/manufacturing.
Be able to correctly determine material properties for structural analysis and elements optimum to subjects.
Be able to conduct messing which reduces calculation costs within the range guaranteeing enough accuracy.
Be able to determine correct load/boundary conditions under consideration of usage environments.
Be able to correctly express analysis results, and analyze impossibility/uselessness of design.
Be able to understand/explain the social necessity of design utilizing CAE system.
